title: Fomo Kernel Question Episode
description: One replayable miss: a synthetic state fixture, the question that was asked, and answers with the verdict each must receive. The readable contract; evals/run_episodes.py holds the enforcement, because the offline suite carries no jsonschema dependency.

id.description: Stable episode id. Sequential, not an issue number: one issue can yield several episodes.

title.description: What went wrong, in one line.

kind.description: real_use_miss carries only de-identified failure structure; no real ticker, amount, or date survives conversion.

refs.description: Issue numbers or run identifiers this episode was converted from.

date.description: When the miss was observed (ISO date).

moment.description: Where in the flow the question sat, in product language: question_queue, commitment, post_card.

fixture.description: The state fixture. Replayed through review.py prepare on every run, so the episode's engine facts are always the current engine's rather than a committed mirror.

trades.description: Synthetic CSV. Only mock fixtures are permitted; the privacy boundary in CLAUDE.md is not negotiable.

question.description: The unit under evaluation: one question, answered.

kind.description: An engine question kind (resolved against the plan's question_queue), commitment_choice (resolved against card_plan.candidate_rules), or free_form for a user's own question. An engine kind the fixture stops queueing fails the episode instead of passing vacuously.

text.description: What the user was actually asked.

checks.description: The mechanical validators that bear on this episode. A declared check with nothing to inspect fails the episode.

must_disclose.description: Honesty keys this answer's claims depend on. Verified to be a subset of what the fixture triggers. Requires honesty_coverage in checks.

answers.description: At least the recorded miss and one repaired answer. An episode whose every answer passes cannot prove its checks still look at anything.

fails.description: Required when expect is fail: exactly the checks this answer must fail. Failing a different set is a failure — the episode is no longer grading what it was written to grade.

note.description: Provenance or de-identification notes for a reader.

prose.description: Free-form answer text the user would read.

presented_options.description: A choice surface as the user saw it.

maps_to.description: The canonical engine value behind this option: a card_plan.candidate_rules[].id at the commitment moment, or a canonical choice value at a question moment.

discloses.description: honesty key -> the one digit-free sentence that disclosed it.
